title: Hold a gaming machine licence
what: Possess, buy, supply or service gaming machines only as the Act's licences allow (a gaming machine licence for the venue).

sources.title: Gaming Machines Act 1992 (SA)
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: 45—Offence of being unlicensed (1) A person must not— (a) have possession of a gaming machine on any premises;

sources.title: Gaming Machines Act 1992 (SA)
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.locator: s 16, words naming the body (found 18 Nov 2026)
sources.quote: The Commissioner may grant to the holder or former holder of a gaming machine licence a temporary authorisation to possess (but not to operate) gaming machines if the authorisation is necessary or desirable to enable the orderly disposal of gaming machines the holder or former holder is no longer authorised to operate.
